description: This file defines the ValidKeysConstraint class used for validating that all keys in a mapping are valid and required keys are present within Drupal's validation system, utilizing Symfony Validator components.

classes.name: ValidKeysConstraint
classes.description: A constraint class that checks if all keys in a mapping are valid and required keys are present, used within Drupal's validation framework.

methods.name: getDefaultOption
methods.description: Returns the default option name for the constraint, which is 'allowedKeys'.

methods.name: getRequiredOptions
methods.description: Returns an array containing 'allowedKeys' as a required option for the constraint.

methods.name: getAllowedKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the list of valid keys based on the current context, considering explicitly allowed keys or inferring from the mapping.
